style: Realistic editorial photograph, natural soft light, refined and calm, shallow depth of field. Palette of deep teal, ivory, sage green and warm wood with a small touch of plum. Diverse adults of different ages, genders and ethnicities, natural expressions, always fully clothed, respectful and professional, safe for a health-education website. No readable text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no nudity.

covers.prompt: A female psychotherapist in a beige cardigan sitting in an armchair, listening with warm attention and a gentle expression, offering a box of tissues across a small table to a woman patient seen partly from behind, safe and supportive therapy room with plants and soft daylight.

A male gynecologist in a white coat at his desk showing a young woman a teal silicone menstrual cup, reusable cloth pads and period underwear laid out on the desk between them, both smiling, bright consulting room.

Product-style editorial photo on a clinician's desk: a curated set of body-safe silicone sexual wellness devices in teal, plum and ivory (a smooth wand massager, a small bullet vibrator, a curved internal massager), neatly arranged on linen next to a sterilizing case and a clipboard, with a sex therapist's hands holding one device to explain it. Clinical, discreet, tasteful, non-explicit, no body parts shown other than hands.

A friendly male pediatrician in a light blue shirt talking calmly across a desk to a mother and her teenage daughter seen mostly from behind and the side, open and trusting conversation, warm consulting room with plants.

A mother and a father sitting together at a sunlit kitchen table, an open illustrated picture book about animals and plants between them and a notebook, talking calmly and thoughtfully about how to explain things to their child, warm home, soft morning light.

An older male physician with grey hair and round glasses taking notes on a structured form on a clipboard while listening to a woman patient across the desk, attentive and unhurried, a stethoscope and a plant on the desk, warm office light.

A woman in her thirties sitting pensively on a wide windowsill in a quiet room, wrapped in a soft knit cardigan, looking out at a misty garden in golden morning light, seen in side profile, a feeling of healing and resilience.

A male gynecologist explaining to a young woman using a plain white educational 3D model of the human pelvis on the desk, an open medical book beside it, both leaning in with curiosity, bright and respectful consulting room.

A father in his forties and his teenage daughter, seen from behind, walking hand in hand along a sunlit garden path lined with ferns and soft mist, a feeling of protection and care, golden hour light.

A woman in her thirties relaxing on a bright sunlit sofa at home on a quiet morning, wearing a comfortable knit sweater and leggings, smiling softly while holding a cup of tea, a book and a plum throw blanket beside her, a plant on the windowsill. Self-care, wellbeing and self-knowledge.

A male sex therapist seated in an armchair taking notes while a couple sits close together on a sofa holding hands and looking at each other with relief, a calm therapy room with plants, tissues and a window with soft light.

A female therapist guiding a male patient in his thirties through a relaxation exercise: he sits in an armchair with eyes closed and hands resting on his knees, breathing calmly, she sits beside him speaking softly, a quiet room with plants and warm light.

A man in his forties at a wooden table by a window writing in a thought-record notebook, crossing out a line and writing a new one, a thoughtful and lightened expression, a cup of tea and a plant beside him.

A male clinical researcher in a white lab coat and glasses looking into a microscope in a bright modern laboratory, glass slides and a petri dish on the bench, teal-toned lighting, focused and scientific.

A woman in her thirties lying relaxed on ivory linen sheets with her eyes closed and a calm contented expression, covered up to the shoulders by a plum-coloured throw, warm window light, a few dried flowers on the pillow, sensorial and subtle, fully covered and tasteful.

A male lecturer at a seminar pointing to a large smooth wave-shaped curve with phases drawn on a whiteboard (no readable text), in front of a small mixed audience of attentive health professionals seated at a table with notebooks, bright training room.

A male doctor in a white coat studying a plain white anatomical model of the female pelvis held in his hands, with an open anatomy atlas on the desk and a reading lamp, concentrated and scholarly expression, library-like office with plants.

A male surgeon in teal scrubs and a surgical cap standing in a clean hospital corridor looking thoughtfully at a clipboard, serious and careful expression, cool teal light, blurred operating room behind him.

A woman in a white bathrobe sitting on the edge of a bathtub in a bright bathroom, applying moisturiser to her calf, a metal safety razor, wax strips and a folded towel on a wooden stool beside her, relaxed and careful, covered and tasteful.

A male pharmacist in a white coat counselling a woman customer across a bright counter, holding two plain unlabeled bottles and a leaflet, both attentive and smiling, soft teal and ivory interior with plants.

A diverse group of five health professionals discussing around a large wooden table covered with books and notebooks, one person gesturing while explaining, engaged and collaborative atmosphere, a bookcase and plants behind them, warm daylight.
